entries.rationale: Run automatic Git maintenance synchronously in the disposable fixture; retain cleanup errors, real packing and no-op checks. No production or pilot policy change.
readerPaths: CI failure → fixture review record → test → exact-head delivery evidence
entries.navigationImpact: No new entry-page navigation; delivery PR links the focused review record.
entries.languageStrategy: German first and English second in the same review record.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Focused Bash CLI and PowerShell parity tests, complete maintenance regressions, native CI and post-merge check; confirmed results recorded in delivery PR.
entries.risk: Only disposable fixture Git settings change; existing no-op, conflict and cleanup assertions remain. No production Git configuration change.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Git lifecycle, fixture, sync or distribution contract changes.
